effectSummary.ko: 일제 소탕을 선택하면 첫 파동이 표식 대상을 맞혔을 때 그 대상만 2초간 30% 둔화시킵니다. 그림자 추격을 선택하면 첫 유효 그림자 적중 후 최대 HP 12% 보호막을 4초간 얻습니다. 한 궁극기 시전당 한 번입니다.
effectSummary.en: With Killing Rain selected, its first pulse slows a marked target it actually hits by 30% for 2s. With Shadow Pursuit selected, the first valid echo grants a 12% maximum-HP barrier for 4s. Once per ultimate cast.

description.ko: 10m 안의 반경 4m에 0.5초 간격으로 6차례 화살을 내립니다. 매 회 최대 8명에게 D80% 물리 피해를 줍니다. 위치는 시전 시 고정되며 A02 시전이나 A06 충전 사격으로 처리하지 않습니다.
description.en: Rain arrows at a fixed point within 10m, in a 4m radius. Six pulses 0.5s apart deal D80% physical damage to up to 8 enemies each. These are not A02 casts or A06 charged shots.

description.ko: 8초간 이동속도가 20% 증가합니다. 기본 공격 또는 A01·A02·A07·A08·A13·A14의 첫 직접 적중 뒤 같은 대상에게 D60% 암흑 추가 피해를 줍니다. 시전당 1회, 초당 1회, 총 8회까지이며 추가 피해는 충전을 쓰거나 발동을 재생산하지 않습니다.
description.en: Gain 20% movement speed for 8s. After the first direct hit of BASIC, A01, A02, A07, A08, A13 or A14, deal D60% secondary shadow damage to that target. Limit once per cast, once per second and 8 procs total; echoes consume no charges and trigger no further procs.

concept: One finger ring with two interlocking asymmetrical bezels: a pale silver arrow-fan half and a dark onyx shield half enclosing a small green core. Broad bronze band and open central ring hole; two hunts structurally joined, no split image panel.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LA46, Oath of Two Hunts, class Ranger, slot finger ring.
Subject design: One finger ring with two interlocking asymmetrical bezels: a pale silver arrow-fan half and a dark onyx shield half enclosing a small green core. Broad bronze band and open central ring hole; two hunts structurally joined, no split image panel.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: With Killing Rain selected, its first pulse slows a marked target it actually hits by 30% for 2s. With Shadow Pursuit selected, the first valid echo grants a 12% maximum-HP barrier for 4s. Once per ultimate cast.
Direct skill context: A17 Killing Rain — Rain arrows at a fixed point within 10m, in a 4m radius. Six pulses 0.5s apart deal D80% physical damage to up to 8 enemies each. These are not A02 casts or A06 charged shots.; A18 Shadow Pursuit — Gain 20% movement speed for 8s. After the first direct hit of BASIC, A01, A02, A07, A08, A13 or A14, deal D60% secondary shadow damage to that target. Limit once per cast, once per second and 8 procs total; echoes consume no charges and trigger no further procs.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
